import os,re
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
    k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
    rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
    if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
        G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
I=G['Demo pair 1 input']; O=G['Demo pair 1 output']
# find changed cells
ch=[(i,j,I[i][j],O[i][j]) for i in range(len(I)) for j in range(len(I[0])) if I[i][j]!=O[i][j]]
from collections import Counter
print(Counter((a,b) for _,_,a,b in ch))
# rectangles of 0s, 1s etc
def rects(grid,val):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    seen=set(); out=[]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if grid[i][j]==val and (i,j) not in seen:
                # bounding box flood
                stack=[(i,j)]; cells=set()
                while stack:
                    a,b=stack.pop()
                    if (a,b) in cells: continue
                    cells.add((a,b))
                    for x,y in ((a+1,b),(a-1,b),(a,b+1),(a,b-1)):
                        if 0<=x<h and 0<=y<w and grid[x][y]==val and (x,y) not in cells:
                            stack.append((x,y))
                seen|=cells
                is_=(min(c[0] for c in cells),min(c[1] for c in cells))
                ie=(max(c[0] for c in cells),max(c[1] for c in cells))
                full=len(cells)==(ie[0]-is_[0]+1)*(ie[1]-is_[1]+1)
                out.append((is_,ie,len(cells),full))
    return out
for v in (0,1):
    print(v, rects(I,v))
